verses.25:28: يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰ لَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيلࣰ ا

meaning: In the Quran, فُلَان is an indefinite placeholder meaning “so-and-so” or “such a person,” used when a person is left unnamed.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
meaning_previous: The root فُلَانٌ (fulān) refers to "such a one" or "so-and-so," used as a placeholder for a person's name, typically male. فُلَانَةٌ (fulānah) is its female equivalent.
